mechanisms: YouTube Shorts ad-revenue share (Partner Program)
TikTok Creator Rewards only for videos ≥ 1 min — post a ≥1-min cut on TikTok if you want that programme
Facebook content monetization (Reels/in-stream ads); Instagram has no general ad-revenue share for Reels — brand deals, gifts and subscriptions only
brand integrations once the format has an audience
eligibility: YouTube Partner Program: 1,000 subscribers + 10M public Shorts views in 90 days (or 4,000 watch hours) — Shorts RPM is far below long-form
TikTok Creator Rewards: 10,000 followers, 100,000 views in 30 days, original videos over one minute
Reused or AI-mass-produced content can be ineligible under YouTube's "inauthentic content" policy — the execution must be original

opportunities.caution: A calendar window (0 days to 2026-10-29): attention collapses right after the date — publish before it or skip; nothing evergreen is being built.
opportunities.nextCheck: What would change the verdict: two or more other creators publishing their own version (the cluster would reclassify as a meme or a format); examples in English or Spanish.
